stance_rationale: Reject the alpha candidate for admission: v5 correctly declares honest empirical fail, but the package still exports a deployable-looking full-confidence alpha vector and lacks several audit artifacts. The no-admit/pivot decision is directionally right; the artifact still needs revision to prevent silent downstream use.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260508_002/alpha_scores_v5.parquet has 43526 rows over 125 YM_target x Ticker dates; 2026-05 is forward-only with y_actual NA. However qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260508_002/alpha_scores.parquet is absent and alpha_scores_v5 lacks an explicit sig_date column.

RF-A2.evidence: The ensemble ICIR=0.0899 is below selected pred_xgb ICIR=0.1895; package avoids this by selecting XGB, but the ensemble mechanism adds no value.

RF-A3.evidence: Recent 3Y pred_xgb ICIR=0.4564 exceeds full ICIR 0.1895 x 1.5 = 0.2843.

RF-A4.evidence: Sector-neutral track is pred_ens_secneutral, not a sector-neutralized pred_xgb selected-alpha track.

RF-A5.evidence: Independent top-decile pred_xgb panel join found minimum 20d TV about 210.6M KRW, above both 1e8 and 2e8 floors.

RF-A6.evidence: Multi-trial DSR views N=7/40/560 are reported, and all are failing; any undercount would not rescue the alpha.

RF-A7.evidence: Multi-date alpha_scores_v5 exists, though canonical qepm/stage_artifacts path and weights schedule are absent.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: v5 selects top factors per sig_date via load_month_factors(sig_date), not 2024-12 snapshot.
Universe/Admin/Size/Vol_KRW_20d are taken from YM_features = YM_target - 1 month.
v5 applies Vol_KRW_20d >= 2e8 KRW at YM_features.
Factor values use Z_Score_Aligned; no NEGATE_FACTORS or FLIP_SIGN pattern found in v5 scripts.
factor_db_connector alignment filters IC history with Usable_Date <= sig_date.
v5 factor access goes through load_month_factors(sig_date).
BM_TSMOM_12m is shifted by one month; no same-day DD/regime overlay found.
No raw DART financial-statement columns are manually loaded; fundamental lag is inherited through Factor DB.

critical_concerns.description: Selected pred_xgb fails the alpha gates: rank_IC=0.0193 < 0.04, ICIR=0.1895 < 0.20, Harvey t=1.45 < 3.0, DSR=-35.78 < 0.5, and monotonicity=0.6121 < 0.80.
Max-20 operational simulation fails hard constraints: net SR=-0.034 and annual turnover=10.60, above the 6.00 hard turnover cap.
Recent 3Y ICIR=0.4564 exceeds full ICIR x1.5, while the 2018-2021 subperiod mean IC is negative; this is an RF-A3 overfit/regime concentration warning even before admission.
RF-A4 is not tested on the selected alpha: the sector-neutral evidence is for pred_ens_secneutral, while the exported best model is pred_xgb.

AX-008 remains incomplete: canonical qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260508_002 is absent, weights.csv and covariance.parquet are absent, risk/optimization packages are absent, and lineage references a missing run_all.R reproduction command.
The package exports a 348-name alpha_vector and confidence_vector=1 for every name despite operational_alpha_pass=false; downstream tools must not treat this as an admitted signal.
Academic references still lack page-level core_reference evidence, so the Charter mechanism checklist is not fully satisfied even though the empirical fail makes admission moot.

supporting_arguments: v5 materially improves PIT hygiene versus v4: rolling factor selection, t-1 universe/liquidity, 2e8 KRW floor, forward 2026-05 row with y_actual NA.
The package honestly marks DISCOVERY_FAIL_HONEST_PIT_PROPER and NOT_ELIGIBLE_HONEST_FAIL.
Top-decile liquidity passes the RF-A5 tradability floor in the v5 panel join.
C13/C14/C15 evidence is comparatively strong through load_month_factors and Usable_Date filtering.
unresolved_disputes: No weights.csv schedule exists, so max_names=20, bounds [0,0.20], sum(weights)=1, and realized schedule turnover cannot be independently verified.
No covariance.parquet exists, so PSD and post-shrink condition number <=100 cannot be verified.
No Pre-LB / Lockbox / Combined 3-way report is provided.
No selected-model sector-neutral pred_xgb audit is provided.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile assumption is that exporting a full-confidence forward alpha vector is harmless because the package also says operational_alpha_pass=false; that relies on every downstream consumer honoring the no-admit flag.
rebuttal_required: Null out the alpha_vector or set confidence to 0 unless the package is admitted, or add a machine-enforced no_deploy flag consumed by downstream stages.
Provide sector-neutral diagnostics for the selected pred_xgb signal, not only the ensemble.
Fix lineage reproducibility: add the actual reproduction command, remove missing run_all.R, and populate method_shopping_log_ref/windows.
Either provide weights/covariance artifacts or explicitly scope this package as alpha-only and block risk/optimizer continuation.
Add page-level core references or reduce the academic mechanism claims to non-admission background.
rationalization_red_flags: legacy_context: conservative; minimal impact for residual extraction
v5_risk: Factor preselect via PIT-rolling top-80 is data-driven not hyperparameter search

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I independently reach the same no-admit endpoint, but the remaining risk is artifact governance: a failed alpha should not be exported as a full-confidence signal that downstream stages could accidentally consume.

alpha_specific_questions: Can the selected pred_xgb alpha survive sector-neutralization on the same selected signal?
Will downstream optimizer/risk stages hard-block operational_alpha_pass=false, or can the exported vector still be consumed?
Where is the Pre-LB / Lockbox / Combined 3-way report for the v5 diagnostics?
